ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism supplies the energy for the food web shown?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the box at the very top of the food web diagram is labeled "cattails plant". From "cattails plant" there are arrows pointing to the "mosquito" and "earthworm" below, and in the figure there are no arrows pointing to "cattails plant". Other animal boxes include mosquito, earthworm, spotted salamander, shrew, northern copperbelly water snake, great egret, etc., and the arrows point from the food source to the eater. Reasoning: in a food web, those that supply energy are usually producers, that is, plants; the arrows show energy being passed from plants to consumers. Because the topmost "cattails plant" is a plant and no other organism provides energy to it, it is the energy source of this food web.
